title: S. Korea, US, Japan foreign ministers to meet amid signs of strain in Seoul-Washington ties
caption:
Unresolved friction over nuclear facility disclosures and delayed command handovers is putting pressure on ties between Washington and Seoul. Senior diplomats convened in Atlanta to address rising strategic disputes.
